permission_denials.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, re, sys
try:
    import yaml
except ImportError:
    print("no yaml module"); sys.exit(0)
text = open("journals/2026-08-24-products-3-500s.md").read()
fm = re.match(r"^---\n(.*?)\n---\n", text, re.S).group(1)
core = yaml.safe_load(fm)
schema = json.load(open(".claude/skills/investigate/journal.schema.json"))
try:
    import jsonschema
    jsonschema.validate(core, schema, format_checker=jsonschema.FormatChecker())
    print("schema: OK")
except ImportError:
    print("no jsonschema module; parsed YAML OK")
ids = {e["id"] for e in core["evidence"]}
for h in core["hypotheses"]:
    for r in h["evidence_for"] + h["evidence_against"]:
        assert r in ids, (h["id"], r)
rc = core.get("root_cause")
if rc:
    assert any(h["id"]==rc["hypothesis"] and h["state"]=="validated" for h in core["hypotheses"])
from datetime import datetime
s = datetime.fromisoformat(str(core["investigation"]["started"]).replace("Z","+00:00"))
c = datetime.fromisoformat(str(core["investigation"]["concluded"]).replace("Z","+00:00"))
print("wall clock ok:", int((c-s).total_seconds()) == core["usage"]["wall_clock_seconds"], "refs ok")
EOF
